text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services recommends stop control for the minor street at the uncontrolled intersection of Broadway Avenue and Rowley Avenue in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow.

North York Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory stop control for northbound and southbound traffic on Rowley Avenue at Broadway Avenue. 2. Directed Transportation Services staff to undertake focused consultation, particularly with the impacted homeowners, prior to proceeding with the installation of compulsory stop control on Rowley Avenue at Broadway Avenue.
